name: lookup_zipcode
description: Resolve a ZIP / postal code to its place info — city, state/province, latitude/longitude — for any of 60+ countries. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "where is ZIP X" / "what city is postal code Y in" / "lat-lon for ZIP Z". Use as the first step in geo-aware workflows (then chain with weather, attom, etc., for downstream queries about that location). Free, sub-second, no auth.

zipcode.description: ZIP or postal code to look up (e.g. "90210").

name: lookup_city
description: Get all postal codes (ZIP codes) for a city, given its country and state or province. Country and state may be written as names or codes — "California" and "CA" both work, as do "United States" and "US".

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — "United States", "US", "Germany", "DE" all work.

state.description: State, province or UK region, by name or abbreviation — "California" or "CA", "Ontario" or "ON", "England" or "eng".

city.description: City name, e.g. "beverly hills". Spaces are fine — pass the name as written.
